propositions: Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, causing dense multi-criterion runs to defer all record calls until budget exhaustion while achieving zero incrementally banked verdicts

Completion contract relied on untrusted ticket-context prompt instructions to serialize evidence and commit actions, violating the documented Incremental banking invariant when prompt wording alone cannot enforce one governed action per response

A finite state machine with explicit response-level enforcement must guarantee that each criterion is banked after at most three evidence actions, with a fail-closed provisional met=false fallback at response three if evidence has not demonstrated MET

The completion-only wrapper policy must atomically claim one governed action per run_step, count unique evidence responses for the live first-unbanked criterion id, and invoke record_criterion_verdict under lock to enforce the banking contract before budget exhaustion

Dense repository runs with five criteria and 240 files previously produced zero CriterionBank writes after consuming full request budget; the repair must achieve at least 2/3 bounded success with normal evidence-backed PASS/FAIL verdict instead of CompletionRecoveryError
